Join us for our first Open Morning as Brighton College Prep Hove officially opens its doors. 📅 Saturday 19 September
This is a wonderful opportunity for families to:
✨ Meet our Headmaster, Mr Philip Smith ✨ Explore our beautiful grounds and facilities ✨ Learn more about our vision for an exceptional education for children aged 3–11 Be part of the beginning of something special.
Welcome from the Headmaster
Welcome to Brighton College Prep Hove, a leading independent preparatory school in Hove for boys and girls aged 3 to 11. Windlesham School and Nursery will become Brighton College Prep Hove in September 2026. Our school is a place of kindness and opportunity, where children develop a genuine love of learning and the confidence to thrive.
As part of the award-winning Brighton College family of schools, we are committed to delivering an outstanding education that balances academic excellence with a deep focus on each child. Our curriculum is broad, forward-thinking and intellectually stimulating, designed to challenge and inspire young minds, while preparing them for senior school and beyond.
We believe that an exceptional prep school education recognises the individuality of every child. At Brighton College Prep Hove, pupils are known, valued and supported to discover their strengths, pursue their interests and approach new challenges with confidence and curiosity. Kindness is also at the heart of our community. We nurture thoughtful and open-minded young people who take pride in their achievements and show empathy and respect for others - qualities that will serve them throughout their lives.
Our close partnership with parents ensures that every child is fully prepared for their next steps. Pupils move on to a wide range of leading senior schools, most notably Brighton College, supported by expert guidance throughout the process.
The very best way to appreciate the warmth, energy and ambition of our school is to visit. I warmly invite you to attend one of our Open Mornings, or to arrange a personal tour and experience Brighton College Prep Hove for yourself.
I look forward to welcoming you and your family.
Philip SmithHeadmaster
Who We Are
At Brighton College Prep Hove, we provide a nurturing and supportive environment in which every child is encouraged to thrive.
A Love of Learning
We have the highest aspirations for all our pupils and enable them to achieve their full potential in every area of school life.
Beyond the Classroom
Our children learn much more than the curriculum. Their lessons are enriched with trips, workshops and visits to inspire and encourage their engagement with the wider world.
Prep School News
From Windlesham to Cambridge
Brighton College Prep School Opens in Hove
Celebrating World Book Day
Visit us
The best way to experience life at Brighton College Prep Hove is by visiting us at an Open Morning or on a personal tour. During your visit, you can meet pupils and teachers, ask questions, and gain a genuine insight into what makes our school such a special place.
Join the Prep School
Begin your journey at our Prep School, where kindness underpins school life, curiosity is inspired, confidence is built and every child is valued.

Governors
An Introduction from the Executive Head
I am delighted to bring over a decade of experience in educational leadership to my role as Executive Head of Brighton College Prep Hove. During this time, I have gained experience as a senior leader in both Junior and Early Years education at Brighton College where my previous roles have included Head of Nursery and Pre-Prep, Head of Admissions & Communications, and Senior Deputy Head at the Prep School.
I currently serve as Director of Prep Schools at Brighton College International, where I support the development of both new and established schools across the Brighton College network. I am passionate about fostering excellence in our schools to ensure that all children reach their full potential and are fully prepared for the next stage of their education. I bring a global perspective and a deep understanding of how to embed the Brighton College values of Curiosity, Confidence and Kindness in our Early Years and Junior settings.
I look forward to working closely with the Headmaster, Mr Philip Smith, and with the governing body here at Brighton College Prep Hove.
Joanne WerganExecutive Head of Brighton College Prep Hove
The Board of Governors
Our Board of Governors possess amongst them a wealth of experience across a variety of disciplines. As our charity Trustees, they use their knowledge to maintain the best interests of the School, its property and its funds.
Christine Mannion-Watson Jack CornishKathryn Duckenfield
Clerk to the Governors - Fiona Kidney
If you would like to contact a member of the Board of Governors please email pa@windleshamschool.co.uk, phone 01273 553645, or write to the Clerk to the Governors at Brighton College Prep Hove, 190 Dyke Rd, Brighton & Hove, BN1 5AA.

A Part of Society
We believe in nurturing kind and compassionate children who are equipped to make a positive difference in the world.
Through initiatives such as our annual Make a Difference Day, alongside ongoing fundraising projects led by our pupils, children are encouraged to take an active role in supporting others and contributing to their community.
We also foster strong partnerships with local organisations, helping pupils to understand the importance of community engagement. By teaching children to be a part of society, not apart from it, we ensure they develop a sense of responsibility, empathy and purpose that extends far beyond the classroom.
From their earliest days in Nursery, pupils develop an understanding of the importance of caring for the environment.
Through our Beach School, children take part in beach clean initiatives, learning about recycling, sustainability and the importance of protecting marine life. These hands-on experiences help foster a sense of responsibility for the world around them.
Within our school grounds, our gardens provide further opportunities for learning, as pupils grow their own herbs, fruits and vegetables. These are carefully harvested and used in our school kitchen, helping children to understand where food comes from and the value of sustainable living.

The best way to experience life at Brighton College Prep Hove is by visiting us at an Open Morning or on a personal tour. During your visit, you can meet pupils and teachers, ask questions, and gain a genuine insight into what makes our school such a special place.

pageCache.text:
Join us for our first Open Morning as Brighton College Prep Hove officially opens its doors. 📅 Saturday 19 September
This is a wonderful opportunity for families to:
✨ Meet our Headmaster, Mr Philip Smith ✨ Explore our beautiful grounds and facilities ✨ Learn more about our vision for an exceptional education for children aged 3–11 Be part of the beginning of something special.
How to Apply
Brighton College Prep Hove provides children with a happy and caring community in which to grow and learn. Curiosity and confidence thrives in a vibrant and forward thinking co-educational environment.
The ideal way to get to know us is at one of our Open Mornings, or on a personal visit.
To apply for a place for your child in any of our year groups, please complete our application form. Once complete, please return to our admissions team at prephoveadmissions@brightoncollege.net
All children who apply for a place will be invited to our school for an assessment day or taster session.
For younger pupils applying to Nursery and Reception, this involves a taster session alongside children of a similar age, giving us the opportunity to assess their readiness to thrive in our setting, while also getting to know each child as an individual.
Children applying for Years 1 to 6 will also be invited into school to meet our teachers and pupils. During their visit, they will complete assessments in English, maths, verbal and non-verbal reasoning.
Following a successful assessment, an offer of a place will be made. Once you have confirmed your acceptance, we will send a welcome information pack and invite you and your child to meet their teacher and new friends towards the end of the summer term.
Year Group Calculator
Enter your child's date of birth to see their main entry points.
If you are interested in any other entry points, please contact Admissions.
Your child is ready for Senior School
Apply for a place at Brighton College through their website.
Getting to us is Easy
Situated between Brighton and Hove, Brighton College Prep Hove offers a well-connected location with the benefits of both city vibrancy and seaside calm.
Visit us
Visit us to find out what makes a Brighton College education so special.

pageCache.text:
Join us for our first Open Morning as Brighton College Prep Hove officially opens its doors. 📅 Saturday 19 September
This is a wonderful opportunity for families to:
✨ Meet our Headmaster, Mr Philip Smith ✨ Explore our beautiful grounds and facilities ✨ Learn more about our vision for an exceptional education for children aged 3–11 Be part of the beginning of something special.
Moving to Sussex
Welcome to the start of your family’s next great adventure
There is a distinct sense of space that comes with living in Sussex, from the clear air of the South Downs to the open views across the English Channel.
It is a place where childhood feels exactly as it should – defined by the freedom of the hills, the energising coastal breeze and a genuine connection to the natural world.
At Brighton College Prep Hove, we are rooted in the heart of Sussex. On the edge of the South Downs National Park, a stone’s throw from the beach and surrounded by a wonderfully vibrant and welcoming city, this is the most fabulous place to call home. For those seeking space, serenity and a world-class education for their children, Sussex isn’t just a place to live – it’s a place to flourish.
From the bohemian energy of Brighton’s Lanes to the timeless charm of our medieval villages, Sussex offers a rich tapestry of experiences. We can help you explore the rolling hills, the rugged coastlines, and the vibrant communities that make our home city the happiest (and sunniest!) city in the UK.
The Happiest City in the UK
Voted the UK’s 'Happiest City' by Time Out magazine in 2026, Brighton offers the best of both worlds: the vibrancy of city life and the tranquillity of the coast. Brighton is a place defined by its vibrant energy and open-minded spirit, where seaside tradition meets modern creativity, offering families a life filled with independent culture and a community that celebrates individuality.
The Lanes
A labyrinth of independent spirit where historic flint-walled alleys meet artisan jewellers and the city's celebrated coffee houses. It is a neighbourhood defined by its creative character and a year-round celebration of culture.
The Cultural Calendar
From the world-renowned Brighton Festival to the vibrant Open Houses, the city acts as a living gallery. It offers an inclusive community spirit where art and performance are woven into the fabric of everyday life.
The Iconic Promenade
The seafront remains the city’s social hub, connecting the historic piers with modern beach-side life. It is a place for sunset strolls or fresh seafood by the shore, offering a sense of openness that defines the Brighton experience.
A City of Independence
As a ‘walkable city,’ Brighton allows pupils to navigate safely between the sea, the shops and the College. This accessibility grants children a rare sense of freedom as they grow, as the city becomes a familiar and manageable part of life at the College.
Refined Coastal Living
While Brighton brings the energy, Hove offers a sense of calm sophistication. Known for its broad, tree-lined avenues and grand Victorian villas, it is a favourite for families seeking a more measured pace of life and a permanent coastal retreat. Life here is centred around the expansive Hove Lawns and the quiet elegance of the seafront.
The Avenues
The Avenues are defined by their sense of openness and historic villas, offering quiet privacy and architectural permanence where grand architecture meets the serenity of the coast.
Hove Lawns
Life in Hove revolves around the iconic Hove Lawns – a vast stretch of green separating the town’s stunning Regency terraces from the pebbled shoreline of the English Channel. From beach-hut gatherings to morning dog walks and quiet evening stolls, it is the social heart of the community.
Calm Sophistication
Beyond the seafront, Hove is home to fabulous bistros, artisan bakeries, local bookshops and specialist wine merchants. From quiet morning coffees in tucked-away cafés to long weekend lunches in family-run restaurants, the lifestyle here is effortlessly chic, providing a village-like feel within the city.
Coastal Equilibrium
With green spaces like Hove Park and St Ann’s Well Gardens, alongside its own mainline station with direct connections to London and the South Coast, Hove offers a truly enviable balance. It is a location that manages to provide both coastal tranquillity and seamless convenience for the modern professional.
Why We Love Brighton & Hove
Voted the UK’s happiest, sunniest and most dog-friendly city, it is easy to see why so many families call Brighton & Hove home. From its vibrant energy to its restorative coastline, here are ten reasons to fall in love with ‘London by the Sea’.
One
The Clean Sea Air
From Sunday strolls to triathlons and marathons, the Brighton coast offers it all. There is nothing quite like the iconic pebble shoreline to clear the mind. The sea air and panoramic views at every turn are a daily luxury that refreshes both parents and children alike, with the water offering a unique sense of freedom – from summer dips to the bracing ritual of year-round sea swimming.
Two
A City of Endless Choice
Whether you’re seeking a relaxed evening at Soho House or a high-energy adventure along the seafront, you will never be short of choices in Brighton & Hove. From immersive escape rooms and glow-in-the-dark golf to the thrill of the zip wire, the city is a playground for all ages.
Three
A Culinary Destination
The Brighton & Hove food scene is a masterclass in variety. With an impressive list of Michelin-recommended restaurants and chic organic eateries, the city rivals the best of London. Yet, for those days when you crave something more grounded, nothing beats our world-famous fish and chips by the sea.
Four
A Cultural Powerhouse
Brighton & Hove is a city of constant inspiration. As home to the renowned Brighton Festival and the vibrant Fringe Festival, the cultural calendar is unparalleled. From the oldest cinema in Britain to a nationally celebrated comedy scene and thriving music venues, the city is a living gallery of performance and heritage.
Five
Countryside Meets Coast
Nestled within a UNESCO Biosphere, the city is a gateway to the South Downs National Park. From rolling hills to the biodiversity of the coast, this is a vibrant natural playground where children grow up active and curious, with an unparalleled connection to the great outdoors.
Six
High Street to Historic Lanes
The city centre is a maze of constant discovery. From the iconic high street names to the twisting, historic Lanes filled with vintage emporia and independent boutiques, Brighton & Hove offers a shopping experience like no other.
Seven
A Family-Focussed Community
Voted one of the friendliest cities in the UK, Brighton & Hove is a place defined by kindness and acceptance. It is a world-class environment for families, offering everything from the thrills of the Palace Pier and the historic Volk’s Electric Railway to the wonders of the world’s oldest aquarium.
Eight
A Legacy of Heritage
From an ancient fishing village to the largest city in Sussex, our history is vast. Mammoths once roamed these shores and Iron Age forts still overlook the city. It was the Prince Regent who truly defined our elegance, establishing Sussex as his royal retreat and commissioning the Royal Pavilion – a landmark of architectural grandeur that remains at the heart of our city.
Nine
Small City, Big Connections
Beyond its coastal charm, Brighton offers an effortless link to the capital and the world. With London Victoria under an hour away by train and Gatwick Airport just a 30-minute drive, the city provides the perfect base for those balancing a global professional life with a coastal home.
Ten
Home to the Best School in the UK
Brighton is home to Brighton College – the UK’s ‘School of the Decade’, which was recently named ‘Top Co-educational School in the UK 2025 & 2026’ and ‘UK Boarding School of the Year 2025 & 2026’ by The Sunday Times.
The Village Collection
While the coast offers energy, the Sussex countryside combines rural charm with easy access to the city. It is a landscape of ancient woodlands and hidden valleys, offering a tapestry of characterful villages – all within easy reach of our school. Discover the unique character of our neighboring communities and find the one that fits your family's pace.
Ditchling is beloved for its artistic heritage and historic cottages; it offers a strong community feel just at the foot of the South Downs.
Lewes is an historic market town defined by an independent spirit, Georgian architecture and a thriving café culture.
With its picturesque high street and iconic village pond, Lindfield represents the pinnacle of idyllic country living.
Steyning is a charming market town with a strong sense of community, tucked within the natural beauty of the South Downs.
A prestigious hamlet tucked beneath the rolling hills of the South Downs, Fulking is famed for its breathtaking views, natural springs and timeless charm.
Rottingdean is an historic seaside village defined by its iconic windmill and Kipling Gardens, with a picturesque beach and a welcoming community, just a few minutes from the College gates.
Known for its 11th-century church and quiet, flint-walled lanes, Ovingdean provides a tranquil rural retreat nestled into the South Downs just moments from the vibrancy of the city.
Alfriston is a picturesque village tucked into the Cuckmere Valley, known for its medieval heritage and refined, slow-paced lifestyle.
Renowned for its classic village green, boutique shops and grand period homes, Cuckfield offers a quintessential English lifestyle.
Henfield is a charming village offering wide streets, historic character and a peaceful lifestyle surrounded by Sussex farmland.
Bolney is a prestigious parish known for its beautiful period properties and its reputation as a gateway to the county’s finest vineyards.
Hassocks the perfect bridge for commuters, combining rural charm with direct, rapid rail links to London and the coast.
A Sussex Sanctuary
The Sussex property market reflects the diverse character of the region, offering a stunning range of homes to suit every family’s pace.
Whether you are drawn to the architectural grandeur of a Regency townhouse overlooking the sea, glass-fronted cliff-top homes with panoramic views, or a flint-walled countryside estate just minutes from the College gates, the options are as varied as the landscape itself.
For those seeking a true sanctuary, the region provides an enviable sense of space. From spacious seafront apartments to secluded detached houses with generous gardens, Sussex offers the privacy and scale that modern family life demands. It is a place where you can find a permanent retreat without compromising on the convenience of a city-center education or a seamless connection to London.
If you are beginning your search, our Admissions team is always happy to provide recommendations for local estate agents who understand the needs of families moving to the area.
Planning Your Move
If you are considering a move to Sussex, we are here to help. Our Admissions team can provide a warm introduction and answer those initial questions that come with a family relocation.
The Elements of Adventure
Living within the South Downs National Park means the ‘great outdoors’ starts at your garden gate. The landscape is more than just a backdrop; it is an active part of growing up and a setting for unforgettable family life.
From the revitalising energy of the coast to the quiet heights of the South Downs, the region offers a natural freedom that encourages children and parents alike to stay curious and active. It is about the balance of a busy school day with the restorative power of shared time outdoors – a lifestyle that is as wholesome as it is adventurous. This is where resilience is built, where families reconnect and where childhood finds its natural equilibrium.
On the Water
From family sailing at world-class marinas to the invigorating ritual of sunrise sea swims, the English Channel is our most vibrant playground.
Across the Ridges
For those who prefer the countryside, miles of mountain bike and hiking trails wind through the South Downs, offering a physical challenge and a mental reset that no screen can replicate.
Through the Forest
Explore the ancient bridleways of the Ashdown Forest – a breathtaking landscape of peace and tradition, located just a 30-minute drive from the city.
World-Class Dining on your Doorstep
From the world-renowned vineyards that dot the South Downs to the hidden gastropubs found at the end of a country lane, the region is a haven for those who appreciate good food and fine company.
Sussex is a place where ‘local’ really does mean the best of the best, where a Sunday lunch follows a walk on the hills, and a world-class glass of sparkling wine is grown just a few miles from home.
The Many Vineyards of Sussex
Sussex has become the heart of the English wine industry, with its chalky soils producing sparkling wines that rival the very best. Whether it’s a tour of the spectacular Rathfinny Estate or a tasting at Ridgeview, these vineyards offer a sophisticated way to spend a Saturday afternoon in our own backyard.
Coastal and City Flavours
In Brighton & Hove, the energy is just as impressive. The city is home to a vibrant, independent food scene, from fresh seafood on the seafront to the artisan bakeries and specialist boutiques of The Lanes. We have sophisticated dining with a relaxed, coastal soul.
The Village Pub
There is something uniquely Sussex about 16th-century pubs tucked away in flint-walled villages. From the seasonal menus to the open fires, these are the spots where families come together to share a meal after a day in the fresh air.
A Landscape of Curiosity
Living in Sussex means being immersed in a landscape that has inspired writers, artists and thinkers for centuries.

Welcome from the Headmaster
Welcome to Brighton College Prep Hove, a leading independent preparatory school in Hove for boys and girls aged 3 to 11. Windlesham School and Nursery will become Brighton College Prep Hove in September 2026. Our school is a place of kindness and opportunity, where children develop a genuine love of learning and the confidence to thrive.
As part of the award-winning Brighton College family of schools, we are committed to delivering an outstanding education that balances academic excellence with a deep focus on each child. Our curriculum is broad, forward-thinking and intellectually stimulating, designed to challenge and inspire young minds, while preparing them for senior school and beyond.
We believe that an exceptional prep school education recognises the individuality of every child. At Brighton College Prep Hove, pupils are known, valued and supported to discover their strengths, pursue their interests and approach new challenges with confidence and curiosity. Kindness is also at the heart of our community. We nurture thoughtful and open-minded young people who take pride in their achievements and show empathy and respect for others - qualities that will serve them throughout their lives.
Our close partnership with parents ensures that every child is fully prepared for their next steps. Pupils move on to a wide range of leading senior schools, most notably Brighton College, supported by expert guidance throughout the process.
The very best way to appreciate the warmth, energy and ambition of our school is to visit. I warmly invite you to attend one of our Open Mornings, or to arrange a personal tour and experience Brighton College Prep Hove for yourself.
I look forward to welcoming you and your family.
Philip SmithHeadmaster

Beach School
Learning meets the sea in Hove, where the classroom extends to the coast and curiosity leads the way.
Our Beach School takes full advantage of our exceptional coastal setting, giving pupils the opportunity to explore, discover and learn in the natural environment on our doorstep.
From Nursery through to Year 6, children spend time on the beach engaging in activities that encourage curiosity, creativity and independence. Whether exploring natural materials, observing the coastal landscape or working together on outdoor challenges, pupils develop confidence and a deeper understanding of the world around them.
Beach School inspires a sense of adventure and a lasting appreciation for the outdoors, learning through experience while making the most of our beautiful seaside location.
Mindfulness by the Sea
Mindfulness is introduced from an early age, with activities such as yoga and breathwork helping children to develop calm, focus and body awareness. These sessions are often taken to the beach, where our coastal setting provides a peaceful and inspiring space for reflection and movement.
Listening to the rhythm of the waves and focusing on steady breathing, pupils experience the physical and mental benefits of being fully present. Time by the sea encourages relaxation, balance and wellbeing, helping children to reset, recharge and return to their learning with clarity and confidence.
